name: Get the Goods

faq.answer: Friz is the buyer willing to pay for the goods Caravaneer Ruzzgot collects from the Bloodsail Buccaneers in Booty Bay.
The pirates stashed the shipment in a chest on the hill just outside Booty Bay.
faq.q: Where did the Buccaneers leave the goods?

aliases: are the pirates friendly to friz
faq.answer: It is Caravaneer Ruzzgot who deals with the Bloodsail Buccaneers for goods Friz will pay for, claiming the pirates are good friends while still wanting muscle along.
faq.q: Why does Friz deal with the Bloodsail Buccaneers?

aliases: why does friz want a liaison
faq.answer: Caravaneer Ruzzgot, not Friz, asks you to serve as his liaison and show of force in case the pirates go back on the deal.
faq.q: Why does Friz ask you to go?

sections.body: Ruzzgot expects a shipment in Stranglethorn Vale, bought from the Bloodsail Buccaneers for whatever Friz is willing to pay. The pirates claim they stashed the trunk on the hill outside Booty Bay for safekeeping. Ruzzgot insists they are trusted friends, yet he wants an armed companion along as a deterrent. You head out past town to inspect the pirate trunk.
sections.title: A Deal with Pirates

summary: In Booty Bay, Caravaneer Ruzzgot has arranged to collect a shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers for Friz. Though he claims the pirates are friends, he wants you along as muscle while you check the trunk stashed on the hill outside town.
